articles.title: Chandrasekaran steps down as chairman of Tata Sons ahead of AGM on August 18
articles.summary: N Chandrasekaran has resigned as Tata Sons chairman and will not seek reappointment, though his term ran to February 2027. The exit follows months of deadlock after one board director withheld support for his extension, and no successor has been named ahead of the AGM on August 18. Matters for trading: Tata Sons anchors a large slice of Nifty market value, and a leaderless holding company is a governance risk the market must now price.

articles.title: Sensex crashes 600 points, Nifty nears 24,250; investors lose  ₹3 lakh crore; key factors behind market selloff explained
articles.summary: The Sensex fell more than 650 points (0.80%) to an intraday low of 77,498 and the Nifty 50 slid toward 24,250, a second straight session of losses, with investors down about Rs 3 lakh crore. IT led the decline while PSU banks bucked the trend. Matters for trading: this is a macro-driven selloff (crude, rupee, US CPI) rather than company-specific, so index-level exposure is what is being hit.

articles.title: INR loses further momentum as oil prices ascend on Hormuz led tensions
articles.summary: The rupee fell 6 paise to 95.42 per US dollar as Brent crude pushed toward $90 a barrel, with hopes of a quick US-Iran agreement and a reopened Strait of Hormuz fading. Reports of fresh attacks on shipping added to the pressure. Matters for trading: India imports the bulk of its oil, so crude strength feeds straight into the rupee, imported inflation and the RBI's room to cut rates.

articles.title: US July CPI seen rising moderately, Fed rate outlook in focus
articles.summary: US July consumer price data is due today, with economists expecting a moderate rise that would further temper expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike this year, though inflation stays above target. Matters for trading: the print lands after Indian market hours and sets the tone for foreign flows into Indian equities tomorrow.

articles.title: Gold rises ₹1,182 on MCX, silver gains ₹2,314 on investment demand
articles.summary: Gold futures on MCX rose Rs 1,182 and silver gained Rs 2,314 on investment demand, with Comex gold near $4,475 an ounce and silver around $66. Matters for trading: for an Indian buyer the rupee price is pushed by two engines at once, the dollar gold price and the falling rupee, which is why local gains outpace global ones.

articles.title: Sebi reviews margin framework to improve commodity market efficiency
articles.summary: SEBI is reviewing the margin framework for commodity derivatives to improve efficiency, alongside wider foreign portfolio investor access, simpler settlement rules and lower participation costs while keeping safeguards. The regulator will continue talks with the GST Council on issues affecting participants. Matters for trading: lower margins and more participants generally mean better liquidity and tighter spreads in commodities.

articles.title: MCX shares rise 2% as JPMorgan upgrades, raises target price after this Sebi proposal
articles.summary: MCX shares rose more than 2% after international brokerages including JPMorgan upgraded the stock and raised targets, following SEBI's proposal to let foreign portfolio investors trade physically settled non-agricultural commodity derivatives. Matters for trading: exchanges earn on volume, so any rule change that widens the participant base flows directly to revenue.

articles.title: TCS, other Tata stocks fall up to 4% as N Chandrasekaran resigns
articles.summary: Tata group companies fell up to 4% led by TCS, the group's largest listed company by market capitalisation, after Chandrasekaran's resignation ahead of the August 18 AGM. Matters for trading: nothing changed in TCS's business today, only the expectation about who runs the group, which is a textbook case of price moving on expectations rather than fundamentals.

articles.title: Tata group stocks may shrug off Chandra's exit in the long run: Analysts
articles.summary: Analysts told Business Standard that Tata group stocks are unlikely to be materially affected in the long run by Chandrasekaran stepping down, even as TCS, Titan, Tata Communications and Tata Motors PV traded down up to 4% intraday. Matters for trading: worth reading alongside the selloff itself, as it shows the gap between an immediate repricing and a considered view of value.

articles.title: Nifty PSU Bank index surges 2% in weak market; PNB, UBI gain up to 5%
articles.summary: The Nifty PSU Bank index was the top sectoral gainer, up about 1.6% at 11:31 AM against a 0.74% fall in the Nifty 50, with PNB and Union Bank of India rallying up to 5%. Matters for trading: sector rotation on a red day shows money moving rather than leaving, which is different from broad capitulation.

articles.title: Godrej Consumer Products CEO Sitapati's exit triggers 10% slide in stock
articles.summary: Godrej Consumer Products fell 10% after chief executive Sudhir Sitapati resigned, with analysts expecting near-term pressure on the stock but no change to core strategy. Matters for trading: this is the second leadership exit repricing a stock on the same day as the Tata news, a useful demonstration that markets treat management continuity as a real asset.

articles.title: Lenskart, Delhivery, among 10 stocks with highest increase in DII holdings in Q1. See full list
articles.summary: Domestic institutional investors sharply raised holdings in several companies during the June quarter, with Lenskart and Delhivery among the ten largest increases. Matters for trading: DII buying is the domestic counterweight to foreign outflows, and tracking where it concentrates shows which stories institutions are willing to fund.

articles.title: Changes in presumptive taxation scheme
articles.summary: The 50% presumptive taxation rule for professionals largely continues under the new Income-tax Act, but Section 58(4) introduces a wider restriction on deductions and losses set against presumptive income. The filing due date is August 31, 2026. Directly relevant if you bill consulting income under Section 44ADA.

articles.title: Ola Electric Eyes Up To ₹7,240 Cr Battery Cell PLI Incentives After Timeline Revision
articles.summary: The Centre has revised PLI timelines for Ola Electric's battery cell subsidiary, opening a five-year incentive window through CY2031 worth up to Rs 7,240 crore. The extension gives the company more time to hit milestones and potentially claim incentives across its full 20 GWh allocation.

articles.title: Yulu Bags $93 Mn To Scale EV Fleet, Enter Full-Size Electric Scooter Segment
articles.summary: Yulu raised $93 million (about Rs 887.5 crore) in a Series C led by GEF Capital Partners, split as $63 million equity and $30 million debt. The Bengaluru company plans to expand its fleet and enter the full-size electric two-wheeler segment.

articles.title: Porter posts Rs 6,650 Cr revenue in FY26; profits jump 4X
articles.summary: Porter reported Rs 6,650 crore revenue in FY26 with profit up more than fourfold, having turned profitable for the first time in FY25. The intra-city logistics market is getting more crowded as Uber, Rapido and Delhivery push into two-wheeler parcel delivery.

articles.title: Groww leads stock brokers in July; Sahi records highest 13.6% client growth
articles.summary: India's active broker client base held steady at 4.54 crore in July, roughly unchanged from June. Groww kept its lead and added the most active clients, while Sahi, founded by former Swiggy CTO Dale Vaz, climbed two places into the top 20 on 13.6% client growth.

articles.title: Uber expands Uber Bike to 100 more Indian cities
articles.summary: Uber has extended Uber Bike to 100 more Indian cities, taking coverage past 220 cities across 18 states and one Union Territory, including Jammu, Tirunelveli, Silchar and Jamnagar.

articles.title: World's largest sovereign wealth fund posts record $184 billion profit as it reveals SpaceX stake for the first time
articles.summary: Norway's $2.3 trillion sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest, posted a record half-year profit above $182 billion on a 9.4% return driven by a rally in Asian technology stocks. It also disclosed a 0.05% stake in SpaceX worth just over $1.2 billion, its first such disclosure.

articles.title: Google’s new AI boss inherits a race to catch OpenAI and Anthropic
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's incoming leader faces pressure to close the performance gap with OpenAI and Anthropic, both of which have shipped advanced systems in recent months that drew praise and safety concerns alike.

articles.title: Enterprise AI Spend Gets A Reality Check
articles.summary: The cost of running AI is collapsing, with the price of processing a million tokens falling roughly tenfold each year. Current benchmarks put DeepSeek V4 Flash at $0.14 per million input tokens, OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna at $0.20 and Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 at $1.25, forcing a reassessment of enterprise AI budgets.

articles.title: AI to define this decade as digitalisation defined the 2000s and liberalisation the 1990s, says RBI guv
articles.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged Indian banks to treat artificial intelligence as a board-level strategic commitment rather than a series of technology purchases, warning that institutions which delay will have the transition forced on them. He said AI will define this decade as digitalisation defined the 2000s and liberalisation the 1990s.

articles.title: Houthi attack kills six in first fatalities in Red Sea in over a year; U.S. strikes container ship
articles.summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels killed six people aboard a cargo ship in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the first fatalities from Red Sea shipping attacks in more than a year. Within hours US forces fired missiles at a container ship they said tried to breach their blockade. This is the direct driver behind the crude spike hitting Indian markets today.

articles.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine has sent proposals to US to end war with Russia
articles.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has handed the United States new proposals aimed at ending the four-and-a-half-year war with Russia, with both sides suggesting US negotiators will visit shortly.

articles.title: Israeli raids, arrests continue as UN warns West Bank at ‘breaking point’
articles.summary: Israeli forces arrested at least 23 Palestinians and demolished several homes in the occupied West Bank as the United Nations warned the territory was at a breaking point, with settler attacks continuing.

articles.title: Does The $2.66 Million Seat Inspection On 453 Boeing 737 MAX Jets Signal A New Era Of FAA Oversight?
articles.summary: The FAA has proposed a new airworthiness directive covering seat inspections on 453 Boeing 737 MAX jets at an estimated cost of $2.66 million, just a week after granting Boeing the ability to self-issue airworthiness certificates for the MAX and 787.

articles.title: American Airlines' AI Is Rebooking Passengers Onto Later Flights Without Asking Them
articles.summary: American Airlines is facing growing criticism over its AI rebooking software, which was built to move delayed passengers onto reachable connections but has been altering itineraries erroneously and without asking travellers first.

articles.title: Mass evacuations in Beijing as Typhoon Dolphin brings more torrential rain to China
articles.summary: Thousands have been evacuated from flood and landslide risk areas in Beijing as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin bring torrential rain across northern and central China, with forecasters warning the capital could see more than 150mm in 24 hours.

articles.title: Boat sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba with 95 people on board
articles.summary: A boat carrying 95 people sank on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe with multiple feared dead and rescue operations under way. Police said 90 passengers and five crew were aboard, and the vessel may have been overloaded.
